Album.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains true on success and false on not found.

Album.name: update-nav-order-async

summary.para: Includes the Album in the Navbar if is positive and adheres to the Album.NavbarOrder bounds constraint of the database; the Album is Published; the Navbar is not full. Gives preference to assigning Album.NavbarOrder to , but include Album in Navbar even where is occupied; if aforementioned conditions are met.
Removes the Album from the Navbar if is -1.

The state of the Navbar ordering is treated as contiguous and beginning at index (NavbarOrder) 0 prior to modifying any states. Upon returning with UpdateNavOrderOutcome.Success, the state of Navbar ordering is contiguously sequenced beginning at index (NavbarOrder) 0.

Album.param: The value of the primary key Album.Id of the Album to modify Navbar ordering/visibility.
The NavbarOrder used to dictate reassignment.

returns.para: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains a tuple, with the first value an UpdateNavOrderOutcome detailing the outcome of the operation, and the second value an IEnumerable depicting the Albums appearing in the Navbar, ordered by NavbarOrder, as AlbumDto.

list.item: UpdateNavOrderOutcome.Success to represent that all conditions to modify Navbar order were met, and Album.NavbarOrder was successfully updated; regardless of whether updated state is logically equivalent to the state prior.
UpdateNavOrderOutcome.OutOfBounds to represent that was not adherent to the Album.NavbarOrder bounds constraint; operation cancelled.

UpdateNavOrderOutcome.NotPublished to represent that Album was not published at time of operation, and as such the operation was cancelled; NavbarOrder of -1, prior to and upon completion of operation.
UpdateNavOrderOutcome.NotFound to represent that Album of was not found; operation cancelled.
UpdateNavOrderOutcome.NavbarFull to represent that, in an operation where Album not in Navbar is to be added to Navbar, according to : the operation was cancelled as the Navbar is already full.

Album.name: swap-albums-in-nav-async
Album.summary: Swaps Album.NavbarOrder of two Albums. Both Albums to-swap must be included within the Navbar, within the state present at the time method is called.
Album.param: The primary key Id of one of the two distinct Albums to swap.
The primary key Id of one of the two distinct Albums to swap.

returns.para: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains a tuple, with the first value a SwapInNavOutcome detailing the outcome of the operation, and the second value an IEnumerable depicting the Albums appearing in the Navbar, ordered by NavbarOrder, as AlbumDto.

list.item: SwapInNavOutcome.Success to represent that both individual Albums were found, in Navbar, and their Orders were swapped successfully.
SwapInNavOutcome.NotFoundInNav to represent that one or both of the Albums to-swap were not found in the Navbar.

Album.name: get-nav-included-albums-async
Album.summary: Retrieves all Albums that are included in the Navbar (strictly), ordered by Album.NavbarOrder (ascending).
Album.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains an IEnumerable of the retrieved Albums, with each Album depicted as AlbumDto.

Album.name: publish-album-async

summary.para: Sets Album.Published to true, and includes the Album in the Navbar if is within the bounds of NavbarOrder indices where an Album is considered to be included in the Navbar and the Navbar is not already full.

If the aforementioned properties apply with an indicated : if, treating the Navbar ordering as contiguous and indexed beginning at NavbarOrder 0, is logically occupied by another Album, the Album to be published is appended to the Navbar ordering.
If the aforementioned properties are not adhered to by an indicated , or if no is indicated, the Album is still published.

Where the operation is completed (no exception thrown and the returned task does not contain null) the Album to be published is assigned some non-empty Album.NavTitle if its existing Album.NavTitle is empty (empty; null or whitespace).

Album.param: The primary key Id of the Album to be published.

The optionally supplied Navbar ordering index which may be used to indicate preference to include the Album in the Navbar, and preference for the index at which to assign the Album in the Navbar ordering.
Album.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains the Album of depicted as AlbumDto if found and operation completed, or null if no Album of was found; the operation was cancelled.

Album.name: unpublish-album-async
Album.summary: Sets Album.Published to false, and Album.NavbarOrder to -1: as to satisfy database constraints and to indicate that the Album is not included in the Navbar. At time of completion, where the operation was not cancelled: guarantees that the state of Navbar ordering is contiguously indexed, beginning at NavbarOrder 0.
Album.param: The primary key Id of the Album to be published.
Album.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains the Album of depicted as AlbumDto if found and operation completed, or null if no Album of was found; the operation was cancelled.
